newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico closes seven ports due to bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Mexico closes seven ports due to bad weather.

text.p: Seven ports were closed Monday along the Gulf of Mexico as a polar front hit the area, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a statement.
Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) crude oil port Dos Bocas was listed among those shut as of 1000 local/1600 GMT.
Port authorities confirmed Dos Bocas port in Tabasco state was closed at 0805/1405 because of strong winds.
Officials at crude port Pajaritos in Veracruz state, under the jurisdiction of the closed Coatzacoalcos terminal, said shipping was also halted at the terminal at 0630/1230.
The third of Pemex's major crude ports, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained open at mid-day with lesser winds, port capitan Jorge Luis Rios Macbeth told Reuters.

The ministry said gusts along the Gulf of Mexico reached 45 knots with waves up to 12 feet high. The government is advising smaller boats against sailing along the Gulf of Mexico and Yucatan peninsula because of the polar winds.
Other shut ports included: Altamira and Tampico in Tamaulipas state; Veracruz in Veracruz state and Frontera in Tabasco state.
